You need to at *least* acknowledge the source of the song you used here, as a courtesy to the original creator and from a basic licensing standpoint if you want to consider this fair use. Since you didn't, I will:

This tale utilizes 12 lines from the lyrics of the song "Red Right Hand" by Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds. Information on that song and the artists behind it can be found here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Right_Hand

In the future if you're using unaltered song lyrics in a piece, you need to at least give credit where credit is due.
